details: A recent World Bank report indicates that a prolonged conflict in the Middle East could severely impact Bangladesh's economy. The report forecasts higher inflation, reduced fiscal capacity due to increased energy subsidies, and a weaker current account balance stemming from rising import costs, diminished exports, and lower remittances. This assessment underscores the broader economic vulnerabilities that geopolitical tensions can trigger across regions.
title: World Bank: Middle East Conflict Threatens Bangladesh's Economic Stability

details: The World Bank Group, in partnership with multilateral development banks, has launched "Water Forward," a global platform aimed at improving water security for one billion people by 2030. The initiative seeks to align policy reforms, financing, and partnerships to expand reliable water services and strengthen systems against droughts and floods, crucial for job creation and economic health.
title: World Bank Launches Water Security Initiative for 1 Billion People
